text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer.
To our promised place.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
I wonder what kind of insults await me.

The moment she entered the paddock, the crowd stirred,
their voices a mixture of admiration and disdain.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, this is irresistible.
This feeling...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Half shock, half disgust.
But every single one of 'em is looking at me...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Triple Crown route regulars.
Let's have a good one today."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, tellin' me not to underestimate the Derby, huh?
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't come here to take things lightly!
Don't you dare underestimate the way I live.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
choice_data_list: Yeah, you don't have any regrets, do you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's my starting point.
The place I've longed for since I was a kid. And—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uncharted adversity! The one who overcomes
this and wins is the coolest of all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm on it, Trainer. I'm gonna do this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if my opponents are a bunch of nobodies to me,
I'm gonna win and become a Derby Umamusume!!
